item.firecontrolcompat.beam_riding_missi: Guidance: Semi-Automatic Command to Line of Sight (SACLOS)
Loads into ATGM launchers and AA missile launchers
Rides the laser designator beam to the aim point
Proximity fuse against Sable structures and mianbao / CBCMS / TAOV munitions
5s acceleration to a top speed of 680 blocks/s
High-agility turning for 0.5s after launch (flies at most 3 blocks, 120 degrees or more), then accelerates under 30G overload
Launch mode and proximity range are configurable in the fire control computer's lead settings
Loads only into AA missile launchers
No lock required; auto-searches a 60 degree cone after launch
Tracks Sable structures, compat missiles and countermeasures
5s acceleration to a top speed of 340 blocks/s (Mach 1), 25G overload
